description: Get everything needed to buy one tool from x402 Forge: the x402 URL your wallet pays, the price, and what you receive. Each tool is sold once, to one owner: you get a small x402 server with the tool, Forge stops selling it, and your copy is listed under your wallet. This call itself is free and does not pay; pay the returned buy_url with an x402 client (for example an x402 fetch or payment tool, or the Fizzl Agent Wallet). To use a tool per call instead of owning it, use call_tool.
name: buy_product
title: Buy a tool (exclusive)
